name: The False Flag
description: Confirmed real compromise: process hollowing in svchost.exe and LSASS credential dumping. On top of that real attack, the operator planted Cyrillic strings whose cleanliness contradicts the observed technical profile. The malice isn't Russian; it's the planter's.
devil_advocate: The process hollowing and credential dumping are real structural evidence of intrusion. The Cyrillic strings are planted to divert attribution.

custodyEvents.detail: Memory image and dropper binary acquired.
Deterministic engine ran over the acquired artifacts.

artifacts.description: Process hollowing confirmed in svchost.exe: a legitimate process hosting injected code while presenting as itself. Reflective DLL injection detected. Structural evidence that is hard to fake.

LSASS credential dumping detected. Active compromise confirmed. Included for narrative completeness — the engine's detector suite has no dedicated credential-dumping category, so this artifact is context, not a scored contributor.
Cyrillic strings injected into the dropper. Linguistic profile too pristine, inconsistent with the observed technical OPSEC.

peirce_chain.firstness: Confirmed real attack + planted Cyrillic attribution.
peirce_chain.secondness: The cultural markers are too clean for the attacker's observed technical OPSEC level.
peirce_chain.thirdness: The real attack was used as a canvas to divert blame. The malice is the disinformation, not the nationality.

demo_quote: A genuine false flag has the attack present. VELO separates the real technical evidence from the planted attribution.
